profile.headline: Software Engineer with passion for AI
profile.summary: I am a software engineer and Machine Learning enthusiast. I also enjoy participating in mentorship events for kids and teens, so if you need an industry representative for your event - let me know!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building a cloud platform to power creation of performant, scalable, and affordable GenAI applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Kubernetes · Software Development · Go (Programming Language) · Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer on Azure IoT Solutions team.

Led design effort across five Azure teams and and currently working on a new Azure Resource Provider for an industrial IoT data processing solution. The software I work on allows customers to deploy the solution to their on-premise Kubernetes clusters.

Delivered a feature allowing Azure Active Directory (AAD) Service Principals and Group members to access Azure IoT Central applications. The feature is crucial for large enterprise customers and currently supports hundreds of AAD Groups and Service Principals across multiple tenants.

Helped onboard junior engineers and held regular knowledge sharing sessions on the topics of authentication, k8s operator pattern, and Azure Arc technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented model profiling feature for Azure ML. The feature has been successfully used by our first and third party customers. Find more about this feature in the official documentation linked below.

The service my team owns receives tens of thousands of API calls for  model deployment per day from both internal and external customers. I supported various features that provide our customers with a smooth experience of deploying their models for inference (to production). The features include model deployment itself, service updates and deletions, production of images that can be used for local debugging, etc. The focus was on reduction of customer reported issues and SLA improvement. I also worked directly with external customers to debug setup issues and make sure they can find work arounds for whatever issue they are facing.

Drove the development and implemented various aspects of Arc Enabled Machine Learning. This features allows customers to bring their on premise computes and computes from other cloud providers (e.g. GKE) to Azure and utilize Azure Machine Learning services on them. The feature is currently in preview.

positions.title: Data Scientist II
positions.description:
• Supported research activities for Reveal(X), network traffic analysis service for security.
• Helped research and was the sole developer for productionalizing Privilege Escalation Detection.
• Helped improve the clustering algorithm to identify peer devices on the network.
Technology Stack: Python, PSQL, Kibana, Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer | Data Science
positions.description:
• Supported and developed wire data analytics service for large enterprise computer networks.
• Built detectors to identify various security and performance anomalies in computer networks.
• Supported day to day maintenance and debugging of customer facing service issues.
• Conducted candidate interviews.
Technology Stack: Python, PSQL, Kibana, Docker

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Supported research conducted by the UW DataLab in determining the central visualization in a scientific paper.
• Designed and implemented a survey aimed at authors of scientific papers.
• Delivered the survey to over 500,000 emails and collected over 8000 responses.
• Prepared a poster and cowrote papers that were accepted into IEEE VIS and SIGKDD.
Technology Stack: Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, AngularJS, Django

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
• Wrote an R package which enables users to embed R code inside a TSQL stored procedure, as well as register and execute the stored procedure directly from R development environment.
• Worked closely with PMs to define and balance requirements and technical restrictions.
• Designed the architecture and implemented the functionalities of the package.
• Developed a customer facing API.
Technology Stack: R, SQL, C++

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Undergraduate TA for the Data Abstractions course (CSE 332).
• Taught a weekly section of 20 people.
• Graded homeworks and projects.
• Held biweekly office hours to assist students with understanding the material.

company.name: Computer Science and Engineering Department at the University of Washington, Seattle

positions.title: Associate Data Scientist (Intern)
positions.description:
• Cleaned and normalized the data from customer data sets
• Performed feature mining for employee performance analysis
• Built an interactive web based visualization to communicate the findings.
Technology Stack: Python, D3, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Exploring synchronization in fractal and non-fractal sets of coupled oscillators
• Oscillator network modeling using MATLAB
• Setting up, analyzing, and visualizing experiments 
Technology Stack: MATLAB
